properties.title: Robust glass machine
Bandos Pool
properties.description: The Bandos pool will mark players as followers of Bandos and none of his followers will attack them in the God Wars Dungeon. The effect lasts for one hour.

properties.title: Sulphur Spring
properties.description: The sulphur spring fully restores Prayer points and temporarily boosts it to 10% over maximum. Does not stack with the Altar of Zaros effect.

properties.title: Saltwater Spring
properties.description: The salt-water spring allows for unlimited run energy by restoring run energy to 100% every two ticks for a limited amount of time. Players get an in-game message when the effect has worn off. It lasts a random duration between 9 and 24 minutes, which is re-rolled by simply entering the spring again. Potential durations given are 9, 12, 15, 18, 21 and 24 minutes (3-minute increments). Agility level has no known effect.

properties.title: Thermal Bath
properties.description: The thermal bath heals the player, cures poison, and applies poison immunity for around 14 minutes. For one hour, the bath boosts the player's maximum life points cap by +3 per Constitution level, for a maximum of +297 at level 99. This stacks additively with the life point boosts from bonfires, fortitude, and life point boosting equipment.

properties.title: Mud Bath
properties.description: The mud bath boosts player's Hunter level by 10% (rounded down), making them more likely to catch hunter creatures. This boost will not stack with the boost from drinking a Hunter potion. The bath also temporarily removes the player's scent whilst hunting, effectively equivalent to smoking all traps with lit torch for a period of time. The boost drops by one point every minute.

blocks.html: Move to the thermal bath, north-east of Seegud. There is 'a pile of long brown and yellow egg-shaped stones'. This fire pit requires a pile of eucalyptus logs and one of the five plants in order to disperse the insects.
